object: QSigma-R6e - Carrier telemetry, and cross-verification of the Ohnium atlas
prompt: Three directions were named: cognition telemetry (a dominance trace with energy transfer and projection violence per bridge event), motion as proof-pressure (loss of coherence marks a failure mode: false ascent, energy leakage, bridge absorption), and cosmos-level multiplicity (each bridge endpoint its own fibre with carrier dominance, remainder, return path).
position: Every quantity named already has an exact operator in this repository, verified in R6/R6b/R6c/R6d. This round wires them into a trace and builds DETECTORS for the three named failure modes. It invents no new quantity. Where a named term has no operator, it is left unimplemented and said so rather than approximated.

energy_transfer_per_bridge_event.status: verified R6b: exact 2-cocycle, composition to 4.4e-16, associativity to 1.3e-15
energy_transfer_per_bridge_event.note: additive over a word; eta = exp(-2 kappa) is the survival factor

projection_violence.operator: sqrt(det J) / sqrt|det g_src| -> 8 sqrt2 e^{-4 rho}
projection_violence.note: this is a MEASURED volume-form ratio, not a metaphor

carrier_dominance.operator: the Cayley-Dickson rung, with the Hopf ladder as its boundary
carrier_dominance.status: verified R6c: fibrations exist at dims 1,2,4,8 and stop where zero divisors start

return_path.status: verified R6b: source defect 0, streamed survival e^{-4 rho}

remainder_survives_the_projection.operator: operational trace distance and chi on the retained state

NOT_implemented: cognition, meaning, awareness, or any claim that a trace is a mind
'energy' in any physical sense -- kappa is a log-norm defect, measured in nats, not joules
the Om/AUM cadence as an operator; it is a naming convention with no computational content

Ohnium schema compatibility was originally deferred as unseen. The atlas was then supplied mid-round, so the schema IS seen and this surface emits ohnium.observable-ascent.v2 records. The deferral is resolved, not silently dropped.

failure_detectors.definition: the trace asserts a carrier rung whose algebra has zero divisors, so no Hopf fibration and no norm multiplicativity exist there
a word streams through deeper prefixes than its net element requires
failure_detectors.control: a single-step word, and any word already in Cartan-reduced form, must give kappa_W = 0 to 1e-12

failure_detectors.definition: the source moves appreciably while the operational state does not -- the compactification consuming the step
failure_detectors.detector: source_step = ||M_next - M_prev||_F > tau_src AND operational trace distance < tau_op
failure_detectors.control: the SAME source step applied at rho ~ 0 must NOT fire; if it fires at both depths the detector is measuring the step size and not the depth

predictions.statement: On a clean trace (single-rung, Cartan-reduced steps, shallow depth) no detector fires. False-positive rate exactly 0 over the swept trace.
Each of the three injected faults fires its own detector and only its own detector. The 3x3 confusion matrix is diagonal.

BRIDGE_ABSORPTION fires at large rho and not at small rho for the SAME source step, because the operational response is suppressed by e^{-4 rho}. This is the compactification made visible per event, not a new effect.
Cumulative kappa over a word equals the sum of per-event kappa to 1e-12 -- the trace is exactly additive, so a dominance history can be audited from its events without re-running it.

The full discarded remainder is retained per event and the source return path closes exactly (defect 0) while the operational return does not (survival e^{-4 rho}). Retention is asserted by reconstructing the pre-projection vector from the event record.
The atlas's operational_success_probability equals p_bell(rho) to 1e-12 at every frame, and its Fano ranks equal (7,21,28). These were derived independently on two machines.

controls: clean-trace null: no detector fires on a healthy trace
single-fault isolation: each injected fault fires exactly one detector
depth control for absorption: same step at shallow and deep rho
reduced-word control for leakage: kappa = 0 on a one-step word
ladder control for false ascent: dims 1,2,4,8 do not fire
scalar-collapse control: the remainder is stored as a vector and its norm alone must NOT suffice to reconstruct it -- if it does, the record has been flattened
kill_conditions: any detector fires on the clean trace
the confusion matrix is not diagonal
BRIDGE_ABSORPTION fires at shallow depth for the control step
cumulative kappa disagrees with the per-event sum beyond 1e-12
the retained remainder cannot reconstruct the pre-projection state
any claim that the trace constitutes cognition, awareness, or advantage

evidence_floor.P: the operator identities, all previously verified
evidence_floor.M: detector behaviour on the swept traces and the confusion matrix
evidence_floor.S: that this telemetry is useful for anything. It is an instrument, and no round here shows it finds a fault nobody knew about

stop_condition: Stop after the trace, the three detectors, the controls, and the confusion matrix. Do not build a visualisation, do not claim the instrument has found anything, and do not merge into any Ohnium schema unseen.

typed_remainder.statement: A 1018-line observability module exists on another machine and has not been pushed. This surface is deliberately named differently and kept joinable rather than guessed at, because inventing a compatible schema without seeing theirs would produce a conflict that looks like agreement.

schema_now_seen.source: ohnium_atlas.html supplied by the user, 522953 bytes, NOT committed (uploaded documents are gitignored)
schema_now_seen.note: the round's stop condition originally forbade merging into an unseen schema. Having seen it, this round EMITS to it and CROSS-VERIFIES it; it still does not modify their module, which remains unpushed.

cross_verification.purpose: their atlas contains quantities this repository derived independently. Checking them is a real recomputation in the direction that matters: their artifact against my operators.
checks: operational_success_probability against p_bell(rho) = (1+q^2)/2 over every frame
energy_balance_defect and remainder_record_defect against their own declared tolerances
carrier dimension labels against the Cayley-Dickson ladder
vector length against declared dimension, per carrier record
cross_verification.kill_condition: if their numbers disagree with the verified operators beyond 1e-12, report the disagreement and do NOT adopt either side without resolving it
